subject: TrustBridge tax onboarding — initial docs and verification options
messages:
From: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@trustbridge.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>
Cc: accounts-payable@trustbridge.io
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TrustBridge onboarding — starting tax docs and PO path

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intake call this morning. We're excited to get the PO and access set up. To move forward requested by your procurement team, attaching the tax paperwork we currently have on file. A couple of notes up front: 

- TrustBridge is incorporated in Delaware (EIN on file) but much of our operations run through a UK subsidiary — we can provide a W-9 for the US entity or a completed W-8BEN-E for the UK entity depending on which legal entity you need on the PO.
- We have a notarized EIN letter from our bank and a signed W-8BEN-E draft.

I attached the documents below and can route a DocuSign envelope for signature if that helps. If you need KBA (knowledge-based authentication) verification for the signer, we can run that with our finance contact.

Attachments:
- TrustBridge_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf (application/pdf, 240KB)
- EIN_verification_letter.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

Next steps from our side: tell us which entity you want on the PO (US or UK), and whether a remote notary or bank letter + KBA is acceptable for interim PO issuance.

Best,
Rachel Gomez
Director, Finance Operations
TrustBridge, Inc.
[attachment: TrustBridge_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf]
[attachment: EIN_verification_letter.pdf]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>
To: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@trustbridge.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge onboarding — starting tax docs and PO path

Rachel — thanks, appreciate the upload. Looping in Kimberly (procurement owner) and Ben (payments) to confirm acceptance criteria.

Couple of clarifying Qs so we don't hit a PO stall:
1) Which legal entity should appear on the purchase order (legal name exactly as on W-9/W-8/Wiring instructions)?
2) Who is the authorized signer on the attached W-8BEN-E (name + job title)? We need a signatory chain for our ledger.
3) For EIN verification: would you prefer we accept the notarized bank letter as final evidence, or do you want to run KBA with your signer and provide a DocuSign envelope? Our usual options are:
   - Bank letter + corporate resolution (fast, conditional PO)
   - KBA + DocuSign (preferred for final clearance)
   - In-person / fully notarized wet-ink (rare, slower)

If procurement is okay with a conditional PO while you finalize signatures, we can provisionally issue a PO (no ACH enabled) and move the supplier to 'staged' so you can start onboarding. Kimberly — can you confirm internal risk threshold for conditional PO on bank-letter + corporate resolution?

Thanks,
Diego
Sr. Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@trustbridge.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>
Cc: accounts-payable@trustbridge.io
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge onboarding — starting tax docs and PO path

Diego — thanks for the note. Quick answers below and attaching the same files with signatory metadata filled in.

- Legal entity for commercial contract: TrustBridge, Inc. (DE) — we would prefer PO on the US entity.
- Signer on W-8BEN-E: Ana López, CFO (signed 2025-09-30).

We can do DocuSign + KBA for Ana today if Redwood accepts ID-based KBA. If you prefer bank letter + corporate resolution for conditional PO, we can provide the corporate resolution within 48 hours.

DocuSign link (internal): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/example-doc?envelopeId=0a1b2c

Attachments: same as before — TrustBridge_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf; EIN_verification_letter.pdf

Let me know which path you prefer and we'll move immediately.

—Rachel

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 13:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge onboarding — starting tax docs and PO path

Diego / Ben — reviewed the attached W-8BEN-E and bank letter. A few internal notes and a recommended hybrid acceptance workflow: 

- Risk note: W-8BEN-E alone is OK for withholding review, but our procurement/payments policy requires either a notarized signatory OR KBA + bank letter for ACH/accelerated payments.
- Recommendation (hybrid conditional path):
  1) Accept bank letter (EIN_verification_letter.pdf) + corporate resolution as interim evidence -> issue conditional PO (status: PROVISIONAL). No ACH until we receive DocuSign + KBA.
  2) TrustBridge runs DocuSign with KBA for CFO (Ana López) within 72 hours; once we receive KBA audit trail and DocuSign envelope, we move supplier to ACTIVE and enable ACH/standard payments.

I've attached our internal runbook for conditional PO issuance to use as the checklist: procurement-onboarding-runbook.pdf. If legal needs to weigh in we can pause, but this is our typical path for mixed-entity vendors.

Action items: Diego — confirm provisional PO dates (we typically set a 30-day interim window). Ben — please hold ACH enablement until we have DocuSign KBA evidence.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: procurement-onboarding-runbook.pdf]

Rachel — thanks, that works. Confirming steps and timeline so we're aligned: 

1) Redwood will issue a provisional PO to TrustBridge, Inc. (DE) within 24 business hours. This PO will be labeled PROVISIONAL and valid for 30 days.
2) Payment terms/ACH: Disabled until we receive DocuSign + KBA evidence for Ana López (CFO).
3) Required docs from TrustBridge (to move to ACTIVE):
   - DocuSign envelope with KBA audit trail for Ana López (CFO)
   - Corporate resolution naming authorized signer (PDF)
   - Final W-9 or notarized W-8BEN-E (as appropriate; you indicated W-9 may be preferable since PO will be on the US entity)

4) If you provide bank-letter + corporate resolution immediately, we can start the provisioning so your onboarding work can begin while signatures complete.

Please reply with: (A) whether you want the provisional PO issued to start onboarding now, and (B) an ETA for DocuSign + KBA (if you choose that path).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/TrustBridge

Diego Fernandez
Sr. Procurement Partner
